sentences.text: We have perused the Settlement Agreement dated 6th October, 2023, which is placed on record.
Both, the petitioner and the respondent, are present virtually.
The Settlement Agreement is signed by both the parties and their respective learned counsel.

The learned Mediator has handed over a pay order dated 27th September, 2023, more particularly,
mentioned in Clause 5 of the Settlement Agreement, to the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner in the Court.

The petitioner and the respondent have been living separately since November, 2020 and after several efforts, they have reached a conclusion that it is not possible for them to continue the matrimonial relationship.
In the facts of the case, we are of the view that this is a fit case to exercise the power of this Court under Article 142 of the Constitution of India to dissolve the marriage.

Accordingly, we pass the following order:
i. The marriage between the petitioner - Renuka Sudhir Ahuja @ Renuka Rajkumar Govindwani and the respondent - Sudhir Ahuja solemnized on 28th June, 2020, is hereby dissolved by a decree of divorce by mutual consent under Section 13B(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

16. That no party will claim any right against the property of each other or their family member after obtaining divorce by mutual consent.
17. That parties undertake not to file any complaint/case civil or criminal against each other after this settlement is signed.
18. This agreement has been executed between the parties with mutual consent and without any coercion or collusion.
The parties hereby undertake to abide by the terms and conditions set out in the above mentioned Agreement.
These terms shall form part of the decree; and iv. The decree be drawn in terms of this order.

We record our appreciation for the reasonable stand taken by the parties as well as by their respective learned counsel and the role played by the learned Mediator.
The Transfer Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
Pending application stands disposed of accordingly.
